notes.title: Cat-o-Combo won Indie Cup W'21 Best Audio!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900187/b733d6cc99c59476e62f297537537228620a8975.png[/img]

Meow-hoo! We are so purrrrroud, that Cat-o-Combo won in Indie Cup W'21 Best Audio!

Our goal was to give players best sound expirience! Every step, explode, gem's break, purrrs and meows were meant to please you. Not everything was done as we expected, but we are happy, that jury of the competition, VP Productions, rightly appreciated our efforts

Let's celebrate with cup of milk! (=^･ｪ･^=))ﾉ彡☆

With cat bites, A'Shi
